title: Board of Recreation and Park Commissioners report relative to identifying and contacting artists of existing public art on Department of Recreation and…
text:
[Council File 26-0248]
Board of Recreation and Park Commissioners report relative to identifying and contacting artists of existing public art on Department of Recreation and Parks property with no record of a signed Artist Waiver; evaluating the feasibility of adding appropriate public art pieces to the City’s Permanent Art Collection; and, identifying potential grants and other funding sources for restoration.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Yes
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Report on identifying artists of existing public art on Department of Recreation and Parks property and exploring opportunities for expanding the Permanent Art Collection.
